title: Palindromic Substrings
summary: Count the number of palindromic substrings within a given string.
statement: Count the number of palindromic substrings within a given string. A substring is palindromic if it reads the same forwards and backwards.
constraints: Count every palindromic occurrence, including equal text at different positions.
hints: Every palindrome has exactly one center, either a character or a gap.
Expand outward from all 2n-1 possible centers.
For each center, move left and right while characters match and increment the count.
Center expansion enumerates every palindromic interval exactly once without storing a quadratic table.
editorial: Center expansion enumerates every palindromic interval exactly once without storing a quadratic table.

tests.explanation: Each single character is a palindrome, giving three.
Three singles, two length-two substrings, and one length-three substring give six.
